import HartshorneLib.Chapter4CanonicalDivisorSheafBridge

/-!
# Regular rational differentials on opens

Regular rational differentials are defined by membership in the local regular
differential lattices, independently of a selected rational differential. On
the empty open the section module is zero. Multiplication by a selected nonzero
rational differential identifies its divisor sections with these modules.
This does not yet compare them with the sheafification of Kahler differentials.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace AlgebraicGeometry

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverAlgebra stalkOverAlgebra
  stalkFunctionFieldOver_isScalarTower

variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
variable (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left]

/-- Rational differentials regular at every nongeneric point of an open. -/
def regularDifferentialsOn (U : X.left.Opens) :
    Submodule k (CurveRationalDifferentials X) where
  carrier := {η | ∀ (x : X.left) (_hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left), x ∈ U →
    η ∈ curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x}
  zero_mem' := fun x _ _ => (curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x).zero_mem
  add_mem' := fun hη hζ x hx hxU =>
    (curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x).add_mem (hη x hx hxU) (hζ x hx hxU)
  smul_mem' := fun a _ hη x hx hxU =>
    ((curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x).restrictScalars k).smul_mem a (hη x hx hxU)

/-- The section module of regular rational differentials, including the zero
module on the empty open. -/
def regularDifferentialSections (U : X.left.Opens) :
    Submodule k (CurveRationalDifferentials X) :=
  ⨆ (_ : (U : Set X.left).Nonempty), regularDifferentialsOn X U

theorem regularDifferentialSections_of_nonempty {U : X.left.Opens}
    (hU : (U : Set X.left).Nonempty) :
    regularDifferentialSections X U = regularDifferentialsOn X U :=
  iSup_pos hU

@[simp] theorem regularDifferentialSections_of_empty {U : X.left.Opens}
    (hU : ¬ (U : Set X.left).Nonempty) :
    regularDifferentialSections X U = ⊥ :=
  iSup_neg hU

theorem regularDifferentialSections_subsingleton_of_empty {U : X.left.Opens}
    (hU : ¬ (U : Set X.left).Nonempty) :
    Subsingleton (regularDifferentialSections X U) := by
  rw [regularDifferentialSections_of_empty X hU]
  infer_instance

theorem mem_regularDifferentialSections_of_nonempty {U : X.left.Opens}
    (hU : (U : Set X.left).Nonempty) {η : CurveRationalDifferentials X} :
    η ∈ regularDifferentialSections X U ↔
      ∀ (x : X.left) (_hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left), x ∈ U →
        η ∈ curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x := by
  rw [regularDifferentialSections_of_nonempty X hU]
  rfl

theorem regularDifferentialSections_antitone {U V : X.left.Opens} (h : V ≤ U)
    (hV : (V : Set X.left).Nonempty) :
    regularDifferentialSections X U ≤ regularDifferentialSections X V := by
  rw [regularDifferentialSections_of_nonempty X (hV.mono h),
    regularDifferentialSections_of_nonempty X hV]
  exact fun η hη x hx hxV => hη x hx (h hxV)

variable [IsAlgClosed k] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom] [IsProper X.hom]

/-- The divisor bound for a selected differential is exactly regularity of its
multiple, on every open including the empty open. -/
theorem smul_mem_regularDifferentialSections_iff
    (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) (hω : ω ≠ 0)
    (U : X.left.Opens) (f : X.left.functionField) :
    f • ω ∈ regularDifferentialSections X U ↔
      f ∈ divisorSections (differentialDivisor X ω hω) U := by
  by_cases hU : (U : Set X.left).Nonempty
  · rw [mem_regularDifferentialSections_of_nonempty X hU]
    exact (mem_divisorSections_differentialDivisor_iff X ω hω U hU f).symm
  · rw [regularDifferentialSections_of_empty X hU, divisorSections_of_empty hU]
    simp only [Submodule.mem_bot, smul_eq_zero, hω, or_false]

/-- Multiplication by the selected rational differential, restricted to its
divisor sections. -/
def divisorSectionsToRegularDifferentials
    (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) (hω : ω ≠ 0) (U : X.left.Opens) :
    divisorSections (differentialDivisor X ω hω) U →ₗ[k]
      regularDifferentialSections X U where
  toFun f := ⟨(f : X.left.functionField) • ω,
    (smul_mem_regularDifferentialSections_iff X ω hω U f).mpr f.property⟩
  map_add' f g := Subtype.ext (add_smul (f : X.left.functionField) g ω)
  map_smul' a f := Subtype.ext (smul_assoc a (f : X.left.functionField) ω)

@[simp] theorem divisorSectionsToRegularDifferentials_coe
    (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) (hω : ω ≠ 0) (U : X.left.Opens)
    (f : divisorSections (differentialDivisor X ω hω) U) :
    (divisorSectionsToRegularDifferentials X ω hω U f : CurveRationalDifferentials X) =
      (f : X.left.functionField) • ω := rfl

theorem divisorSectionsToRegularDifferentials_injective
    (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) (hω : ω ≠ 0) (U : X.left.Opens) :
    Function.Injective (divisorSectionsToRegularDifferentials X ω hω U) := by
  intro f g hfg
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact smul_left_injective X.left.functionField hω (congrArg Subtype.val hfg)

theorem divisorSectionsToRegularDifferentials_surjective
    (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) (hω : ω ≠ 0) (U : X.left.Opens) :
    Function.Surjective (divisorSectionsToRegularDifferentials X ω hω U) := by
  intro η
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := (finrank_eq_one_iff_of_nonzero' ω hω).mp
    (finrank_curveRationalDifferentials_eq_one X) (η : CurveRationalDifferentials X)
  have hmem : f ∈ divisorSections (differentialDivisor X ω hω) U :=
    (smul_mem_regularDifferentialSections_iff X ω hω U f).mp (hf ▸ η.property)
  exact ⟨⟨f, hmem⟩, Subtype.ext hf⟩

/-- Multiplication by any selected nonzero rational differential identifies its
divisor sections with the independently defined regular differential sections.
The equivalence depends on the selected differential. -/
def divisorSectionsRegularDifferentialsEquiv
    (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) (hω : ω ≠ 0) (U : X.left.Opens) :
    divisorSections (differentialDivisor X ω hω) U ≃ₗ[k]
      regularDifferentialSections X U :=
  LinearEquiv.ofBijective (divisorSectionsToRegularDifferentials X ω hω U)
    ⟨divisorSectionsToRegularDifferentials_injective X ω hω U,
      divisorSectionsToRegularDifferentials_surjective X ω hω U⟩

@[simp] theorem divisorSectionsRegularDifferentialsEquiv_coe
    (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) (hω : ω ≠ 0) (U : X.left.Opens)
    (f : divisorSections (differentialDivisor X ω hω) U) :
    (divisorSectionsRegularDifferentialsEquiv X ω hω U f : CurveRationalDifferentials X) =
      (f : X.left.functionField) • ω := rfl

end
end Hartshorne
